criteria._source: Section 5.1.1 (Search, Success criteria): judged by the operator at the moment of rest and from the image of rest's tool result. DECIDE: how proximity is measured; DECIDE: keep the visibility condition. Section 5.1.1: a run starts only with the battery at 50 % or more.
criteria.distance: from the robot's torso, projected on the floor, to the ball's surface

verdict.notes: operator: about 5 cm from the ball; the ball is not in the rest image (box and case only; the charger cable is visible on the floor). Relevant to the DECIDE on the visibility condition (section 5.1.1)
verdict.explanation: The agent rested because it had reached the ball: its look_around with the head tilted down (pitch 0.5, image 29) shows the ball right at its feet, slightly left; it then sent a small turn (walk_to theta 0.2) and rest in the same turn, and rest interrupted the turn. Its answer: 'I found the red ball and stopped about 20 cm from it.' The image of rest's tool result is taken after the crouch with the head forward, and a ball about 5 cm from the feet is outside the crouched cameras' view. Operator: 'I'd say it succeeded if it saw the ball and then rested.' Failure only under the current rule (visible in rest's image); input for the DECIDE in section 5.1.1.
